text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After discovering that her team was secretly doing extra training without permission, Ms. Kashimoto mercilessly scolds Team Zenith.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Although she can be harsh and overbearing, Ms. Kashimoto clearly cares about her team. When we ask Director Akikawa why Ms. Kashimoto is so strict, she tells us everything.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Ms. Kashimoto was once a trainer who valued the freedom of Umamusume. However, her trainee was forced to retire from racing after she overworked herself by doing too much solo training and got injured in a race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Ever since, Ms. Kashimoto has been adamant about micromanaging her racers, all in order to protect them from suffering the same fate.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The tragedy took place at the Unity Cup, which is why the competition is especially traumatic for Ms. Kashimoto.
